snippets.snippet_text: "That said, Gumroad reserves the right to issue refunds within 90 days of purchase, at its discretion, to prevent chargebacks. So, if you want to have a 'No refunds' policy, that's fine - but be aware that customers can issue chargebacks anytime against their purchases through their credit card"
